name: Moya Letnyaya Podrabotka
source:
After graduating from high school, you travel to the quiet village of Sleepy Fields to spend the summer with your best friend Leo and your friend Alice. You hope to take a break from the noise of the city and the stress of exams—and most importantly, earn some money before heading off to college.
The plan sounds simple enough. But at the same time, a mysterious new virus known as HPL begins spreading across the country… and it may end up affecting your summer as well.
translation:
高中毕业后，你前往安静的沉睡田野村庄，与你最好的朋友利奥和爱丽丝一起度过夏天。你希望远离城市的喧嚣和考试的压力，最重要的是，在上大学之前赚一些钱。
这个计划听起来很简单。但与此同时，一种名为HPL的神秘新病毒开始在全国范围内传播……它最终也可能会影响你的夏天。
